title: J-space Workspace
description: The Wayfinder's sparse, temporary conceptual manifold for a specific query. Not the full graph — only what's active for the present question. Capacity limit ~20 simultaneously active nodes before concepts compete and degrade (per jlens capacity experiments). The external J-space fiber position (Jacobian world-sheet model) and the model's internal workspace band (Jacobian lens, if available) are recorded separately and may be compared.

activeNodes.description: Nodes currently active in this workspace. Keep under 20 to avoid capacity interference.

activationScore.description: How strongly this node was retrieved and scored

activeEdges.description: Relationships active between nodes in this workspace

retrievedEvidence.description: Evidence packet IDs associated with this workspace

candidateTools.description: Tool IDs selected by discover_tools() for this query

candidateTheoryLenses.description: Theory lens IDs applicable to this query (only those with measurable observables)

externalJspace.description: External J-space fiber position derived from current environmental PREMAQ state. Jacobian world-sheet model: F: ℂ³→ℂ³, det(DF)=-2, three fiber preimages at p1=(0,0,-0.25), p2=(1,-1.5,6.5), p3=(-1,1.5,6.5). Only p1 is physically reachable from real coordinates. (speculative-theory)

state.description: [x, y, z] normalized coordinate in J-space

premaqSnapshot.description: PREMAQ vector at time of workspace creation

modelWorkspace.description: Jacobian lens readout of what the model holds in its internal workspace band. Available only for open-weight models. For closed models (Claude), the external J-space serves as proxy. (established-science for the jlens computation itself)

workspaceBand.description: Layer indices that constitute the workspace band for this model

topConcepts.description: Top-k tokens visible in the workspace band at the query's final position

position.description: Token position in the prompt (-1 = last)

ignitionThreshold.description: If set, the activation score at which a concept was detected as 'ignited' in the workspace (ref: jlens ignition experiments)

crossChecked.description: Whether model workspace concepts were cross-checked against retrieved graph nodes

divergences.description: Concepts in model workspace not found in retrieved graph nodes (potential confabulation risk)

unresolvedQuestions.description: Questions this workspace could not answer; candidates for follow-up

discardedCandidates.description: Nodes or edges retrieved but discarded from the active workspace

reason.description: Why discarded: low relevance | world mismatch | superseded | privacy restriction | capacity limit

linkedEvidencePacketIds.description: Evidence packets produced during this workspace session
